name: Chicken & Parmesan 'Caesar' Wrap
steps: Slice the chicken into thin strips, transfer to a bowl and add both the chargrilled chicken seasoning and the garlic Italian seasoning.
Roughly chop the lettuce. Finely grate the Parmesan.

Spray a non-stick frying pan with the oil over a high heat, then add the chicken strips. Leave to turn nice and golden on one side, then flip. Meanwhile, combine all the caesar dressing ingredients in a bowl and set aside.

Toss the salad into the dressing. Heat the wrap for 10-15 seconds in the microwave to make it more flexible. Layer the chicken into the centre of the wrap, followed by the lettuce, parmesan and cheese mix.
Fold either side in, flattening the mixture down a bit, then flip the wrap over the filling, tuck it under and roll it up.

Give the frying pan you used for the chicken a quick wipe (no need to clean properly), then add some more oil spray to the pan. Pop the wrap on top for a few minutes over a medium heat until it starts to go crispy.
Once golden and crispy, wrap in foil and enjoy!
